definition_zh: 铝土矿；矾土
definition_en: a claylike ore from which aluminum is obtained
core_image: 红褐色土块，嚼一嚼就是铝的故乡
scene: 露天矿场里红土堆成小山，挖掘机轰鸣。 Trucks hauled bauxite from the open pit.
sceneCN: 这里 bauxite 指「铝土矿」（第 1 个义项：炼铝的矿石）；句意：卡车把铝土矿运出露天矿坑。

derivatives.zh: 氧化铝——由 bauxite（基础词，指铝土矿）提炼得到，语义指向其化学产物

senses.title: The aluminum ore
senses.definition: the principal ore of aluminum, a mixture of hydrated oxides
senses.definitionCN: 铝的主要矿石，含水氧化物的混合体
senses.example: Almost all aluminum begins as bauxite.
senses.exampleCN: 几乎所有的铝都始于铝土矿。
senses.why: The rock was first described at Les Baux: the place became the metal's cradle.
senses.whyCN: 该岩石最早描述于莱博村：地名成了金属的摇篮。

senses.title: In industry and trade
senses.definition: bauxite as a mined commodity
senses.definitionCN: 作为开采商品的铝土矿
senses.example: Guinea leads the world in bauxite exports.
senses.exampleCN: 几内亚的铝土矿出口居世界之首。
senses.why: Red rock feeds white metal worldwide.
senses.whyCN: 红色的石头喂养着全球的白色金属。

senses.title: Refined into alumina
senses.definition: bauxite processed into alumina before smelting
senses.definitionCN: 熔炼前先加工成氧化铝
senses.example: The plant refines bauxite into white alumina powder.
senses.exampleCN: 该厂把铝土矿精炼成白色氧化铝粉。
senses.why: Two steps separate red dirt from silver metal.
senses.whyCN: 从红土到银白金属需两道工序。

senses.title: In abrasives and cement
senses.definition: bauxite used for abrasives and aluminous cement
senses.definitionCN: 用作磨料与铝水泥的矾土
senses.example: Calcined bauxite hardens road surfaces.
senses.exampleCN: 煅烧矾土硬化路面。
senses.why: Its hardness serves where metal cannot.
senses.whyCN: 其硬度可用于金属不能之处。

senses.title: Geological deposits
senses.definition: residual deposits formed by weathering in tropical climates
senses.definitionCN: 热带风化形成的残余矿床
senses.example: Ancient tropical soils became today's bauxite belts.
senses.exampleCN: 古热带土壤形成今日的铝土矿带。
senses.why: Rain washes everything away but the aluminum.
senses.whyCN: 雨水冲走一切，独留铝。

senses.title: Named place and town
senses.definition: towns named for the ore, as Bauxite, Arkansas
senses.definitionCN: 以矿得名的城镇，如阿肯色州 Bauxite
senses.example: Bauxite, Arkansas, boomed a century ago.
senses.exampleCN: 阿肯色州铝城百年前一度繁荣。
senses.why: The ore carried its French village name abroad.
senses.whyCN: 矿石把法国小村之名带往海外。

senses.title: In chemistry writing
senses.definition: the mineral name in oxide analyses
senses.definitionCN: 氧化物分析中的矿物名
senses.example: Bauxite is essentially Al₂O₃ with water.
senses.exampleCN: 铝土矿本质上是含水的氧化铝。
senses.why: Science keeps the proper name for the mixture.
senses.whyCN: 科学以专名称呼此混合物。

senses.title: Strategic resource
senses.definition: bauxite as a material of national importance
senses.definitionCN: 被视为国家要害物资的铝土矿
senses.example: Wartime powers seized the bauxite supply.
senses.exampleCN: 战时权力机构接管了铝土矿供应。
senses.why: Aircraft made aluminum a weapon metal.
senses.whyCN: 飞机使铝成为战争金属。

intro.en: Bauxite was named in 1861 after Les Baux, the village in southern France where the ore was first described; the suffix -ite marks the mineral.
intro.cn: bauxite 于 1861 年得名于法国南部村庄莱博（Les Baux），该矿石最初在此被描述；后缀 -ite 为矿物名标志。

items.en: Les Baux, a limestone village of Provence.
items.cn: 莱博，普罗旺斯的石灰岩村落。

items.en: Henri Sainte-Claire Deville's circle coined bauxite for the ore.
items.cn: 德维尔学派于 1861 年为该矿石造词 bauxite。

items.en: English adopted bauxite with the mineral suffix -ite.
items.cn: 英语随即将 bauxite 连同 -ite 后缀收入。

items.en: The Hall–Héroult process of 1886 made the ore priceless.
items.cn: 1886 年霍尔—埃鲁电解法使该矿石身价百倍。

items.en: The word now names mines, towns, and trade routes.
items.cn: 如今该词指矿山、城镇与贸易航线。

note.en: Group one holds the -ite mineral family and look-alikes; group two holds the ore field.
note.cn: 第一组收 -ite 矿物词族与形近词；第二组收「矿石」义场。

entries.definition: the Provençal village of Les Baux.
entries.definitionCN: 普罗旺斯莱博村。

entries.definition: a salt of boron; unrelated to bauxite.
entries.definitionCN: 硼砂；与铝土矿无关。

entries.definition: not standard; the ore is bauxite.
entries.definitionCN: 非标准拼写；应作 bauxite。

entries.definition: rock containing useful metal.
entries.definitionCN: 含金属的岩石。

entries.definition: the oxide refined from bauxite.
entries.definitionCN: 由铝土矿精炼的氧化铝。

entries.definition: an iron ore with the same -ite suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 赤铁矿；同用 -ite 后缀。

normalIntro.en: bauxite is Baux plus -ite: the mineral of Les Baux.
normalIntro.cn: bauxite 即 Baux 加 -ite：莱博村的矿物。

normal.en: Place: Les Baux, France.
normal.cn: 地名：法国莱博村。

normal.en: Suffix: -ite, mineral.
normal.cn: 后缀：-ite，矿物。

normal.en: Year: 1861.
Use: source of aluminum.
normal.cn: 用途：炼铝之源。

normal.en: Look: red, claylike rock.
normal.cn: 外观：红色黏土状岩石。

abstract.en: See red earth stacked like rusted hills.
abstract.cn: 看红土堆成锈色小山。

abstract.en: Bauxite is a French village packed into ore trucks.
abstract.cn: bauxite 是被装进矿车的法国村庄。

abstract.en: Rain, in the tropics, mines aluminum for free.
abstract.cn: 热带的雨在免费开采铝。

examples.en: Bauxite reserves lie beneath the tropical plateau.
examples.cn: 热带高原下埋藏着铝土矿储量。

examples.en: The refinery turns bauxite into alumina.
examples.cn: 该冶炼厂把铝土矿炼成氧化铝。

examples.en: Bauxitic clay lined the roadbed.
examples.cn: 路基铺着铝土质黏土。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「波克塞」——红色的「盒」（box）子里装的全是铝土

root: 以法国南部村庄莱博（Les Baux）命名，1861 年法国化学界为该铝矿石造词 bauxite；后缀 -ite 为矿物学通用标志，与 hematite 等同族。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses haul one red rock: the ore, the commodity, the refining step, the abrasives, the geology, the towns, the chemistry, and the strategic stakes.
sensesIntro.cn: 八义项运走同一块红石：矿石、商品、炼制、磨料、地质、城镇、化学与战略。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a red village of Provence compressed into ore.
core.cn: 核心意象：普罗旺斯一座红村被压进矿石。

branches.en: Mineral and its tropical geology.
branches.cn: 矿物及其热带地质成因。

branches.en: Trade and strategy move the rock.
branches.cn: 贸易与战略搬运石头。

branches.en: Refining whitenes the ore.
branches.cn: 精炼把矿石洗白。

branches.en: Its hardness grinds and cements.
branches.cn: 其硬度可研磨、可固结。

branches.en: Towns and chemistry keep the name.
branches.cn: 城镇与化学保留其名。

intro.en: The bauxite word rides the great -ite family of mineral names.
intro.cn: bauxite 一词乘 -ite 矿物命名大家族而行。

latinIntro.en: Latin -ita via Greek -ites marks minerals in scientific naming.
latinIntro.cn: 经希腊 -ites、拉丁 -ita 的后缀为科学矿物命名标志。

definition_zh: 水彩；水彩画；水彩颜料；水彩技法
definition_en: a painting medium in which pigments are bound in a water-soluble gum, and a picture made with it
core_image: 清水在纸面洇开，颜料随水流动，一层淡色叠在另一层淡色上
scene: 清晨的窗边，画纸被水洇湿，颜色一层层晕开， The student mixes a pale wash of watercolor for the sky.
sceneCN: 这里 watercolor 指「以水溶性胶调和颜料的水彩媒材」（第 1 个义项：水彩颜料与媒材）；句意为学生调出一层淡薄的水彩来画天空。图中可辨识物件：窗边画纸、水盂、颜料盒与湿开的色层。

senses.title: Pigment bound in water-soluble gum
senses.titleCN: 以水溶性胶调和的颜料
senses.definition: a painting medium made of pigment dispersed in a water-soluble binder such as gum arabic
senses.definitionCN: 把颜料分散在水溶性结合剂（如阿拉伯胶）中的绘画媒材
senses.example: The box holds twelve pans of watercolor and a small brush.
senses.exampleCN: 盒子里有十二块水彩颜料和一支小画笔。
senses.why: The compound names exactly what distinguishes the medium: colour that is carried and thinned by water.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词直接点出这种媒材的区别：由水来承载与稀释的颜色。

senses.title: A picture painted with it
senses.definition: a finished painting made with watercolor paint
senses.definitionCN: 用水彩颜料完成的画作
senses.example: Her watercolor of the harbour hangs above the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 她那幅港口水彩画挂在书桌上方。
senses.why: The medium and the product share one name, so the material word also names the finished object.
senses.whyCN: 媒材与成品共用一个名称，因此材料词也指完成的作品。

senses.title: The art or genre of watercolor
senses.definition: the practice or category of painting in this medium
senses.definitionCN: 使用这种媒材的绘画实践或画种
senses.example: Watercolor has been the society's main medium for a century.
senses.exampleCN: 一个世纪以来，水彩一直是这个协会的主要画种。
senses.why: Once a medium has its own exhibitions and schools, its name stands for the whole artistic category.
senses.whyCN: 当一种媒材有了自己的展览与流派，它的名称就代表整个艺术门类。

senses.title: Made in watercolor (attributive)
senses.titleCN: 水彩的；用水彩画的（定语）
senses.definition: used before a noun for materials, works or techniques belonging to the medium
senses.definitionCN: 置于名词前，指属于该媒材的材料、作品或技法
senses.example: She keeps a watercolor sketchbook in her bag.
senses.exampleCN: 她包里总带着一本水彩速写本。
senses.why: The noun works as a classifier, as in watercolor paper or watercolor class, marking the medium of what follows.
senses.whyCN: 名词可作分类定语，如「水彩纸」或「水彩课」，标记后续事物所属的媒材。

senses.title: A paint product sold in pans or tubes
senses.titleCN: 成块或管装出售的水彩颜料
senses.definition: a commercial paint product formulated for watercolor painting
senses.definitionCN: 为水彩绘画配制的商品颜料
senses.example: Student-grade watercolor costs far less than artist-grade.
senses.exampleCN: 学生级水彩比艺术家级便宜得多。
senses.why: The medium becomes a commodity, so the same word names the item on a shop shelf rather than the art.
senses.whyCN: 媒材成为商品，同一个词便指货架上的物品，而非艺术品。

senses.title: The transparent wash technique
senses.definition: the method of laying thin, transparent washes that let the paper show through
senses.definitionCN: 薄而透明、让纸白透出的层层罩染方法
senses.example: The sky was built from three transparent watercolor washes.
senses.exampleCN: 天空由三层透明水彩淡彩叠成。
senses.why: Watercolor's defining behaviour is transparency; the word comes to name the technique of layering thin colour.
senses.whyCN: 水彩最典型的表现是透明；这个词因此也指层层薄涂的技法。

senses.title: A pale, translucent effect
senses.definition: a figurative look of thin, luminous colour resembling watercolor
senses.definitionCN: 类似水彩的淡薄、透亮色彩效果
senses.example: The morning fog gave the streets a watercolor softness.
senses.exampleCN: 晨雾给街道罩上一层水彩般的柔和。
senses.why: Because watercolor cannot hide the paper, its colours look airy; that visual memory supplies the figurative use.
senses.whyCN: 由于水彩无法遮住纸白，颜色显得轻盈；这种视觉记忆提供了比喻用法。

senses.title: To paint in watercolor (verb, rare)
senses.definition: to paint a subject with watercolor, chiefly in older or technical writing
senses.definitionCN: 用水彩绘制某物，主要用于较早或技术性文字
senses.example: The travel books were watercolored by hand before photography took over.
senses.exampleCN: 在摄影取代之前，这些旅行书是手工上水彩的。
senses.why: English occasionally converts medium nouns into verbs, and this rare use treats watercolor as an action.
senses.whyCN: 英语偶尔把媒材名词转为动词，这一罕用用法把水彩当作一种动作。

intro.en: Watercolor is an English compound of water, from Old English wæter, and color, from Latin color 'colour'. The compound itself is modern English, not a Latin word. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: watercolor 是英语复合词，由表示「水」的英语本族词（源自古英语 wæter）与表示「颜色」的词（源自拉丁 color）合成。复合词本身属现代英语，并非拉丁词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Wæter is the native English word for water, inherited from the Germanic family; its further pre-Germanic history is a reconstruction.
items.cn: wæter 是英语本族的水字，继承自日耳曼语族；其更早的日耳曼语之前历史属重构。

items.en: Latin color meant 'colour, hue, outward appearance'. Its deeper origin is uncertain, and the link sometimes suggested to a root meaning 'to cover' is a hypothesis.
items.cn: 拉丁 color 意为「颜色、色调、外观」。其更深来源不确定；有人把它与意为「覆盖」的词根联系起来，那只是假说。

items.en: English took color through Old French in the thirteenth century, and the spelling without u became standard in American use.
items.cn: 英语在 13 世纪经古法语接受 color，不带 u 的拼写在美式用法中成为标准。

items.en: The compound watercolor appears in the eighteenth century, when painters needed a short name for pigment thinned with water rather than oil.
items.cn: 复合词 watercolor 出现于 18 世纪，当时画师需要一个短名，来指用水而非油稀释的颜料。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the word also named the picture, the exhibition category and the packaged paint sold to amateurs.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪，这个词也指画作、展览类别，以及卖给业余者的成包颜料。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Germanic history of water and the ultimate source of Latin color are both unsettled, so any proposed Indo-European roots are reconstructions.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：water 在日耳曼语之前的历史与拉丁 color 的最终来源均无定论，所提印欧词根均属重构形式。

note.en: The first group contains spellings and sound-alikes that are not the same term; the second contains media that behave differently on paper.
note.cn: 第一组是拼写变体与读音相近但并非同一术语的词；第二组是在纸上表现不同的媒材。

entries.definition: The same word in British spelling; it is not a different medium or a different meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个词的英式拼写，并非另一种媒材或另一个词义。

entries.definition: A machine that cools drinking water; it shares two common words but belongs to offices, not art.
entries.definitionCN: 冷却饮用水的机器；共用两个常见词，但属于办公室而非艺术。

entries.definition: A descriptive form meaning painted or tinted with watercolor, rather than the name of the medium.
entries.definitionCN: 描述性形式，意为用水彩画成或染成，而不是媒材名称。

entries.definition: Water-based paint made opaque with white; it shares watercolor's gum binder but hides the paper.
entries.definitionCN: 加白而成的不透明水性颜料；与水彩共用胶质结合剂，却会遮住纸白。

entries.definition: A thin, fluid layer of colour; it is one watercolor technique, not the medium itself.
entries.definitionCN: 薄而流动的一层颜色；它是水彩的一种技法，而非媒材本身。

entries.definition: Pigment bound with egg or gum on a panel; its colours are opaque and its surface does not rely on paper white.
entries.definitionCN: 以蛋或胶调合、画在板上的颜料；颜色不透明，表面不依赖纸白。

entries.definition: Pigment in a synthetic polymer emulsion; it can be thinned with water but dries into a plastic film.
entries.definitionCN: 以合成聚合物乳液调和颜料；可用水稀释，但干后形成塑料膜。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two real words in the compound, the behaviour of the medium and the phrases it keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：复合词里的两个真实单词、媒材的实际表现，以及它常用的搭配。

normal.en: Water plus color is literally the recipe: pigment carried by water.
normal.cn: 「水」加「颜色」就是字面配方：由水承载的颜料。

normal.en: The paper stays visible through the paint, which is why watercolor has no true white of its own.
normal.cn: 纸白会从颜料中透出来，所以水彩本身没有真正的白色。

normal.en: A wash is colour diluted until it behaves like tinted water.
normal.cn: 「淡彩」是稀释到像带色清水一样的颜料层。

normal.en: Oil paint sits on the surface; watercolor sinks into the paper.
normal.cn: 油画颜料停在表面，水彩则渗进纸里。

normal.en: Travelers once carried a small watercolor box because it needed only water, not oil or solvent.
normal.cn: 旧时旅行者带小水彩盒，只因它只需要水，不需要油或溶剂。

abstract.en: Picture light passing through a stained window instead of bouncing off a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象光穿过彩色玻璃，而不是从墙面上反弹。

abstract.en: Picture a colour that gains strength each time it is allowed to dry and be layered again.
abstract.cn: 想象一种颜色，每次干透后再叠一层就更有力量。

abstract.en: Picture a painting that trusts the blank paper to do half the work.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅画放心把一半的活交给空白纸面。

examples.en: The artist loaded the brush with watercolor and let it run down the page.
examples.cn: 画家把水彩蘸满画笔，任它顺着纸面流下。

examples.en: Her early works are watercolors of the canals near her childhood home.
examples.cn: 她早期作品是童年家附近运河的水彩画。

examples.en: The instruction sheet explains how to keep watercolor from buckling the paper.
examples.cn: 说明页讲解了如何防止水彩让纸面起皱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「watercolor」就是 water 加 color：用水带色。水一多就淡，水一少就浓，纸白透出来就是高光。记住「水带色」三个字，拼写和用法一起记住。

root: watercolor 是英语复合词：前半表示「水」，源自古英语 wæter，属日耳曼语族；后半表示「颜色」，经古法语来自拉丁 color。复合词本身在 18 世纪出现，指以水调和而非以油调和的颜料。两部分的更早来源均无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with the medium itself, then move to the finished picture, the genre, attributive use, the packaged product, the transparent wash method, a pale figurative look and finally a rare verb.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从媒材本身开始，依次到完成的画、画种、定语用法、商品颜料、透明淡彩技法、淡雅的比喻效果，最后是罕用动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: clear water spreading through paper, carrying a little pigment and leaving the paper's white to shine through.
core.cn: 核心意象：清水在纸面铺开，带着少量颜料，把纸白留出来发光。

branches.en: THE MEDIUM ITSELF: the core sense is pigment that water can carry and thin.
branches.cn: 媒材本身：核心义是能被水承载与稀释的颜料。

branches.en: FROM OBJECT TO GENRE: one finished sheet becomes the name of a whole painting category.
branches.cn: 从物件到画种：一张完成的画成为整个绘画类别的名称。

branches.en: CLASSIFIER AND COMMODITY: the word marks paper, classes and the pans or tubes sold in shops.
branches.cn: 分类语与商品：这个词标记纸张、课程，以及商店出售的块装或管装颜料。

branches.en: TRANSPARENCY AS METHOD AND LOOK: thin washes are both a technique and a visual softness borrowed by other media.
branches.cn: 透明兼为方法与外观：薄层罩染既是技法，也是被其他媒介借用的柔和观感。

branches.en: RARE ACTION: the medium briefly becomes a verb, as older travel plates were watercolored by hand.
branches.cn: 罕用动作：媒材偶尔转为动词，如旧时旅行版画由人工上水彩。

intro.en: The compound is transparent English, and its two halves plus two suffixes account for the useful family.
intro.cn: 这个复合词是透明的英语构词，两个词根加两个后缀足以解释其常用词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin color supplies the second half; the first half is native English, and -ist and -ed build the derived words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 color 提供后半部分；前半部分是英语本族词，表示从事者的后缀与分词词尾构成派生词。

items.meaning: the liquid that carries and thins the pigment
items.meaningCN: 承载并稀释颜料的液体
items.example: The first half names the vehicle of the paint.
items.exampleCN: 前半部分命名颜料的载体。

items.example: The second half names what the water carries.
items.exampleCN: 后半部分命名水所承载的东西。

items.example: The compound is younger than either of its parts.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词比它的任一部分都年轻。

items.meaningCN: 同义，只是拼写习惯不同
items.example: British usage keeps the u in the second element.
items.exampleCN: 英式用法在第二部分保留 u。

items.example: The suffix marks a painter who works in the medium.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀标记以此媒材作画的人。

items.meaning: a painter who works chiefly in watercolor
items.example: The society was founded by a group of watercolorists.
items.exampleCN: 这个协会由一群水彩画家创立。

items.example: A watercolored plate is one that has received the paint.
items.exampleCN: 「上过水彩的版画」指已经施以此法的版面。

items.structure: wash (English noun from the verb washan)
items.meaning: a thin layer of diluted colour
items.example: The technique word sits beside the medium word.
items.exampleCN: 技法词与媒材词并列使用。

definition_zh: 年金；养老金；年金保险
definition_en: a fixed sum of money paid each year, or the contract providing it
core_image: 每年准时寄到的一笔钱：像一棵按时结果的树
scene: 退休教师打开信封，里面又是那笔固定的款项。 The retired teacher lives on an annuity from her late husband's pension fund.
sceneCN: 这里 annuity 是「年金」（第 1 个义项：按年支付的固定款项）；句意为：退休教师靠亡夫养老基金支付的年金生活。

derivatives.zh: 拉丁短语借入，义为「每年」

senses.title: A yearly payment of money
senses.definition: a fixed sum paid once a year to a person
senses.definitionCN: 每年一次付给某人的固定款项
senses.example: The trust pays her an annuity of ten thousand dollars.
senses.exampleCN: 信托每年付给她一万美元年金。
senses.why: The Latin annus means year, so the word names a payment defined by the year.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 annus 意为「年」，该词即指以「年」为单位的支付。

senses.title: The contract or investment providing such payment
senses.definition: a financial contract that guarantees periodic payments, usually in retirement
senses.definitionCN: 保证定期给付的金融契约，多用于退休
senses.example: He converted his savings into a life annuity.
senses.exampleCN: 他把积蓄转换成了终身年金。
senses.why: The payment and the legal machine behind it share one name.
senses.whyCN: 支付行为与背后的法律装置共用一个名称。

senses.title: Payments more frequent than yearly
senses.definition: a series of equal periodic payments, even monthly or quarterly
senses.definitionCN: 等额的定期给付序列，即便按月或按季
senses.example: Most annuities now pay monthly rather than annually.
senses.exampleCN: 如今多数年金按月而非按年给付。
senses.why: The yearly frame stretched to fit any equal interval.
senses.whyCN: 「按年」的框架被拉伸以适配任何等距时段。

senses.title: A life annuity: income until death
senses.definition: an annuity that pays until the holder's death
senses.definitionCN: 支付至持有人去世为止的年金
senses.example: A life annuity removes the fear of outliving savings.
senses.exampleCN: 终身年金消除了「人还在、钱没了」的恐惧。
senses.why: The insurance pool trades a lump sum for a promise without an end date.
senses.whyCN: 保险池以一笔一次性款项换取一份没有截止日的承诺。

senses.title: A deferred annuity: payment that starts later
senses.definition: an annuity whose payments begin at a chosen future date
senses.definitionCN: 在选定的未来日期才开始给付的年金
senses.example: Her deferred annuity starts when she turns sixty-five.
senses.exampleCN: 她的递延年金在她六十五岁时开始给付。
senses.why: The promise can sleep for years before it starts paying.
senses.whyCN: 承诺可以先沉睡多年再开始兑现。

senses.title: An annuity in feudal history
senses.definition: a yearly grant of money from a lord, crown, or institution
senses.definitionCN: 领主、王室或机构授予的年度钱款
senses.example: The poet received a royal annuity in 1619.
senses.exampleCN: 这位诗人于 1619 年获得王室年俸。
senses.why: Before insurance, the crown itself was the payer of yearly sums.
senses.whyCN: 在保险出现之前，王室本身就是年款的支付者。

senses.title: Annuity as steady, reliable income
senses.definition: any reliable source of regular income, likened to an annuity
senses.definitionCN: 被比作年金的任何稳定定期收入
senses.example: The hit song became an annuity for its writer.
senses.exampleCN: 那首热门歌曲成了词作者的稳定财源。
senses.why: What pays regularly without further work feels like an annuity.
senses.whyCN: 无需再劳作仍定期入账之物，感觉便如年金。

senses.title: Annuity certain: payments for a fixed term
senses.definition: an annuity that pays for a set number of years, however long the holder lives
senses.definitionCN: 不论持有人寿命长短、给付固定年数的年金
senses.example: He chose an annuity certain for fifteen years.
senses.exampleCN: 他选择了为期十五年的定期年金。
senses.why: The promise can be bounded by years instead of by a lifespan.
senses.whyCN: 承诺的边界可以是「年数」而非「寿命」。

intro.en: Annuity is the Latin year turned into money: a payment that the calendar itself calls for.
intro.cn: annuity 是被金钱化的拉丁「年」：一笔由历法本身召唤的支付。

items.en: The root *at- meant to go, and the completed circuit became the year.
items.cn: 印欧词根 *at- 意为「行走」，走完一圈即为「年」，一般认为如此。

items.en: Annus meant year; the adjective annualis meant yearly.
items.cn: 拉丁语 annus 意为「年」，形容词 annualis 意为「每年的」。

items.en: Annuitas named a yearly payment or obligation in legal documents.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 annuitas 在法律文书中指年付钱款或义务。

items.en: Old French carried annuite into the language of law and finance.
items.cn: 古法语 annuite 进入法律与金融语言。

items.en: English adopted annuity in the fifteenth century, first for royal yearly grants, later for insurance contracts.
items.cn: 英语于十五世纪借入 annuity，最初指王室年赐，后指保险契约。

note.en: Grouped by the shared year-root and by neighboring financial words.
note.cn: 按共享「年」词根与金融近义词分组。

entries.definition: occurring once a year
entries.definitionCN: 每年的，与 annuity 同出 annus 词根

entries.definition: year-by-year historical records
entries.definitionCN: 编年史，同根且同样按年组织

entries.definition: conversion of figures to a yearly rate
entries.definitionCN: 年化计算，同根且同为金融用语

entries.definition: regular payment after retirement
entries.definitionCN: 养老金，与年金常互换但来源多为职业计划

entries.definition: a fixed regular payment, as to a scholar
entries.definitionCN: 津贴；薪俸，多为职业性定期支付

entries.definition: a regular sum provided for a purpose
entries.definitionCN: 定期给予的款项，多指生活或专项津贴

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real annus root and the standard financial family.
normalIntro.cn: 以下记忆钩子基于真实的 annus 词根及标准金融词族。

normal.en: annus = year; an annuity is money that arrives by the year.
normal.cn: annus 表「年」；annuity 即「按年而来的钱」。

normal.en: Same family: annual, anniversary, per annum, biennial.
normal.cn: 同族词：annual、anniversary、per annum、biennial。

normal.en: The annuitant is the person who receives the annuity.
normal.cn: annuitant 是领取年金的人。

normal.en: A life annuity pays until death; a deferred annuity starts later.
normal.cn: 终身年金付至身故；递延年金晚些开始给付。

normal.en: Annals record by year; annuities pay by year: same root, two directions.
normal.cn: annals 按年记录，annuity 按年支付：同根两向。

abstract.en: Picture a tree that drops the same number of coins into your yard every spring.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵每年春天往你院子里落下等量硬币的树。

abstract.en: See a calendar page turning, and with each turn a coin lands in a bowl.
abstract.cn: 想象日历每翻一页，一枚硬币落进碗里。

abstract.en: Feel the calm of a bill you never have to earn again.
abstract.cn: 感受一笔不必再去挣的钱带来的安心。

examples.en: She bought an annuity to secure her retirement income.
examples.cn: 她购买了年金以保障退休收入。

examples.en: The fellowship carries a generous annuity.
examples.cn: 该研究基金附带丰厚的年俸。

examples.en: Royalties from the textbook are his private annuity.
examples.cn: 教科书的版税是他私人的稳定财源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「按年贴」——按年给付、贴补生活的钱，正是 annuity（年金）。

root: 拉丁语 annus（年，源自一般认为的印欧词根 *at-「行走」，走完一循环为一年）→ 中世纪拉丁语 annuitas「年付钱款」→ 古法语 annuite → 英语 annuity（15 世纪）。

sensesIntro.en: From the yearly payment, the word grows into contracts, insurance products, royal grants, and any metaphorical stream of steady money.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「年付之款」出发，词义生长为契约、保险产品、王室年赐，以及任何比喻性的稳定财源。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same sum landing every year, like fruit in season
core.cn: 核心意象：每年准时落下的等额之款，如应季果实

branches.en: the payment itself, by year or by month
branches.cn: 给付本身，按年或按月

branches.en: the contracts that guarantee payment
branches.cn: 担保给付的各类契约

branches.en: historical grants from crown or lord
branches.cn: 历史上的王室或领主年赐

branches.en: steady income in metaphor
branches.cn: 比喻中的稳定收入

branches.en: money that outlives the work
branches.cn: 超越劳作本身的钱财

intro.en: Annuity belongs to the compact ann- year family, all members counting time in years.
intro.cn: annuity 属于紧凑的 ann-「年」词族，所有成员都以「年」计时间。

latinIntro.en: Medieval Latin combined annus with the noun suffix -itas to name the yearly obligation.
latinIntro.cn: 中世纪拉丁语以 annus 加名词后缀 -itas 构成年付义务之名。
